result.summary: Found 2 visible layout issues, primarily in the restaurant listing metadata.

issues.description: The metadata beneath “Tokumaru Ramen Bar” overlaps heavily. The delivery time and delivery-fee text render on top of each other, producing unreadable text such as “25–330delivery.”
issues.suggestion: Place each metadata item in a properly spaced flex row, prevent unintended negative spacing, and truncate or wrap content cleanly on narrow screens.

issues.description: The rightmost cards and category chip are abruptly clipped at the screen edge, including the “Trattoria Picco…” card. Although this may be a horizontal carousel, the cutoff looks harsh and partially hides content.
issues.suggestion: Use consistent carousel gutters and card widths, with a deliberate partial-card preview or horizontal scroll affordance so the clipping appears intentional.
